spans.s:
jña, vbl. knowing, at end of cpds. [√jñā,
333.]

jñātí, m. kinsman; relative. [√jan: cf.
κασί-γνητος, ‘brother-born.’]

jñāna, n. knowledge; wisdom; esp. knowledge
of the higher truths of religion and
philosophy. [√jñā, 1150.]

jñānin, a. wise; possessing jñāna; understanding
(what one reads), 68^15. [jñāna.]
